title: Exactness and thick isomorphism locus of the specified site Hom comparison
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme and $A$ a finite commutative ring. Use the ordinary unbounded derived categories $D_e=D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $D_p=D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], with derived internal Hom $H_e,H_p$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] and their closed symmetric derived tensor structures [lem-sf-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal]. Let $F=\nu_T^*:D_e\to D_p$ be the exact comparison inverse image with its canonical tensor and constant-unit identifications [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism, lem-sf-comparison-pullback-exact, lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Let $\beta_{K,M}:FH_e(K,M)\to H_p(FK,FM)$ be the evaluation transpose specified in [def-sf-evaluation-hom-site-comparison].

For each fixed $M\in D_e$, $FH_e(-,M)$ and $H_p(F(-),FM)$ are exact contravariant functors. The natural transformation $\beta_{-,M}$ commutes with their canonical shift identifications and gives a morphism of the reversed distinguished triangles, including the connecting morphism, for every distinguished triangle of first arguments. Consequently $\{K\in D_e:\beta_{K,M}\text{ is invertible}\}$ is thick: it contains zero and is closed under isomorphisms, shifts, finite sums, cones and retracts [def-weil-triangulated-category]. These assertions concern the specified evaluation transpose, not an arbitrary choice of isomorphisms. Under restriction to any etale object $U\to T$, the comparison agrees with $\beta$ formed on the localized sites and with restricted evaluation, using the canonical inverse-image comparisons and the internal-Hom restriction isomorphisms [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-internal-hom-exact-restriction].

It supplies coherent opposite shifts and exactness with the all-degree quadratic normalization. Compose with the exact comparison pullback and its opposite. proof.text: The shift-compatible natural transformation induces a triangle morphism on the reversed triangle with exactly the required three components. Apply the contravariant isomorphism-locus theorem, whose proof uses triangle two-of-three and retracts in the arrow category, to obtain triangulatedness and retract closure.

proof.text: For etale restriction on either site, use its ordinary closed comparison and its exact extension-by-zero left adjoint. [lem-sf-exact-closed-derived-hom] makes the canonical unbounded derived internal-Hom restriction map invertible. The ordinary comparison pullback square is monoidal: its right-adjoint square is restriction of the same sections, and conjugation preserves monoidality. [lem-sf-exact-derived-tensor-square] derives this actual ordinary square with the canonical transported tensor structures. The chosen comparison tensor structure has those same tensor components; invertible tensor components determine the unit by left unitality, hence determine the whole monoidal structure. Therefore the derived square in the statement is monoidal for exactly the recorded structures. Apply naturality and composition of the canonical internal-Hom comparison to the inverse square, then compose with the square in the source and target. The inverse-isomorphism identities give exactly the displayed restriction equation. This uses the actual etale object morphism, with no open-immersion or boundedness assumption.

It is not superseded (the item and the new id are still unsplit or absent in live and side-live), it answers no repair note, and the statement and stmt_deps are unchanged against live. Route: it realizes paragraph 2 of the main-20261015 lem-weil-finite-duality-site-comparison proof, i.e. triangle morphism, thick dévissage and locality. It uses the arbitrary-ringed-site internal-Hom exactness in place of the étale-only lem-sf-hom-triangulated, which is the blueprint's own remark that the same argument works on the pro-étale site. I accept the generic tool_uses. No SGA citation and no cycle. Steps: (1) exactness from lem-sf-comparison-pullback-exact, the exact-functor leaf, lem-weil-pbc-ringed-internal-hom-exact-restriction and lem-coef-signed-derived-internal-hom-exact. (2) b_E = Hom(1,q)∘c with q:FI→J a K-injective resolution, so FI is never assumed K-injective; it descends by lem-pur-rhom-well-defined. (3) On K-flat models with P→Hom(E,I), the uncurried b is q∘F(ev)∘(tensor comparison)^{-1}; the closed-monoidal counit is the evaluation, so b equals β of def-sf-evaluation-hom-site-comparison. (4) The new node's shift square plus postcomposition give compatibility with the projection-normalized source shift, the same convention on both sites; the connecting square comes from naturality at w[-1]. (5) lem-sf-triangle-morphism-iso, zero, shifts and finite sums. (6) Retract inverse h=B(i)a^{-1}C(p), recomputed by hand. (7) The localize-ringed-site, slice mate-normalization and slice-evaluation-transpose nodes give agreement for every étale U. New node lem-sf-ringed-hom-complex-pullback-shift: statement only, self-contained, source Stacks 0GMX remark-pullback-internal-hom (read). I checked by hand that s:H(E[m],I)→H(E,I)[-m] with (-1)^{mn} is a chain map, and the cases E=O[0], I=N[0] and m=0. It strictly generalizes lem-sf-etale-hom-complex-pullback (scheme morphisms only; ν_T is not one), so it is not a duplicate or a restated clause. Searches recorded with all three kinds. Maintainer notes: the étale node is now a special case of the new one; the projection normalization of the source shift sits in the proof, not the statement, of lem-weil-pbc-ringed-internal-hom-exact-restriction, as other citers already assume.
